extracted.name: Brookville Hotel Sweet and Sour Coleslaw
extracted.description: An easy, 5-ingredient recipe for coleslaw from a famous Kansas restaurant doesn't need mayonnaise. Make the slaw ahead of time and let it chill for several hours before serving. It's great for a potluck.
instruction_lines: Stir cream, sugar, vinegar, and salt together in a bowl until sugar and salt have dissolved; cover and refrigerate dressing for 30 minutes to blend flavors. Pour dressing over cabbage in a bowl, toss to combine, and refrigerate until thoroughly chilled, at least 2 hours.
